scope: ten original learning nodes on the 43 original creation routes; role-owned persistent other skills, not battle formula activation
task_scope_source: client_verified original explicit rows and route edges; never derive IDs from a numeric pattern
skill_identity_source: client_verified player cskillitem/showlist class6/showlistclient; do not substitute same-name500001/500067 or effect10011
grant_id_source: designed task-completion adoption of the verified player identity; no original grant field or bridge was found
grant_value_source: designed initial value1; original packet consumer stores supplied integer, original task grant value unknown
grant_trigger: designed only in the accepted learning-task completion transaction, after current active and exact original AI8001 predecessor has trusted won proof; opening/activation/progress UI alone never grants
existing_skill: designed preserve max(current_supported_value,1), never downgrade or add a second key; an already learned skill does not skip the original task or its120 XP
fee_source: designed explicitly free teaching; original zero task money fields do not prove a server charge rule
timer_source: designed monotonic server minimum1s and lifetime5min; original ProcessBarTime1/client float threshold is verified, absolute original timer unit is not
admission: current adopted role/chapter private1501 directory, actual original route/task/NPC, fresh original-key interaction proof, full MapAddress and entity/map/connection generations, role/position/task/skill revisions, valid current lease, nonbattle/nontransfer, original option0; moves/other menus/transfer/battle/disconnect revoke uncommitted ticket
predecessor: exact original incoming type40 AI8001 accepted through trusted task battle settlement; journal completed alone is insufficient, no fake victory or new production battle registry activation
task_rewards: client_verified original120 role XP and zero pet XP/money/items/prestige; use existing task reward/growth/resource transaction, only unique original successor active0, no later battle/CG completion or early reward
skill_authority: RoleOwner(role_id,login_epoch) is the sole mutable owner; role_skills Module owns persistent known other-skill baseline/revision and immutable full snapshots; caller owns connection and transaction
snapshot_validation: designed known complete class6 player-other-skill map, unique positive signed32 keys and positive signed32 values, current catalog identities and explicit provenance; preserve every supported known entry, reject unknown/malformed/partial baselines rather than fill/drop
baseline: new truly-created roles may receive an explicit known-empty other-skill authorization in their actual creation transaction; historical restoration/chapter labels do not retrospectively prove empty. Existing roles require an explicitly verified complete baseline via a separate public adoption Interface. No implicit initialization, migration or reading an absent table as empty
ledger_interface: public caller-transaction initialization/adoption, immutable current snapshot and expected-revision grant CAS; no internal commit/connect/send or hot DDL/config. Task Module owns stable accepted intent and its grant receipt; paid skips grant CAS and reads current ledger
transaction: first completion atomically verifies current lease/permit/predecessor/directory/versions, applies original task120 XP/growth/resource effects, grants max(current,1) via public skill CAS, saves task/grant receipts and unique successor, and pre-encodes every final native message before commit. Any late SQL/source/encoding error rolls back all effects
retry: same accepted command/immutable intent receipt-first; no second XP/grant/revision increment and no historical value replay. Read and encode the complete current other-skill map, preserving later legitimate learning. New lease loads current authority; stale ticket/callback rejects and does not become new permission
wire_contract: client_verified compact map<i32 skillID,i32 value> plus byte; original consumer removes absent old keys for either flag. Always send complete current known authority, never a one-item delta or guessed empty packet
snapshot_flag_source: designed use original flag1 branch to suppress optional default-shortcut placement; both flags retain complete replacement semantics
login_and_resume: known baseline sends current complete snapshot through current connection owner; unknown ledger sends no guessed map and rejects fresh grant until explicit baseline. A committed task followed by send failure reloads current skills and XP without another grant; writer/drain is outside SQL
stat_and_battle_scope: grant itself adds no invented character stat modifier or resource cap transition and does not mutate inventory revision. Battle skill authorization must separately consume a versioned owned skill snapshot and an approved combat definition; training10MP/damage override is not the formal skill formula
legacy_task_family: 1010xx remains unchanged; no learning node is inserted into its original edges
activation: isolated role-ledger/protocol/task integration and temporary contract-fixture verification authorized; shared creation/login/dispatch and exact release require separate review. Production AI8001/other story battle remains paused and no real character is modified by this policy
